# Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (Nagarjuna Kamireddy / Nagarjuna K)

> Lead AI Architect, AI Solutions Architect, Generative AI & Agentic AI Lead, and Corporate AI Trainer with 20+ years in enterprise data platforms, SAP BW/BPC/HANA consulting, and production Machine Learning & Agentic AI across India, Malaysia, Singapore, the UK, the US, and Dubai, UAE. Currently based in Dubai, UAE and available immediately on employer visa sponsorship across the UAE/GCC, global relocation, and remote leadership engagements.

Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (also published on CVs, GitHub repositories, and enterprise materials as **Nagarjuna Kamireddy**, **Nagarjuna K**, and **Nagarjun Reddy Kamireddi**) most recently served as AI Architect & Technical Lead at **John Deere** (01/2023 – 10/2026), where he owned architecture, a self-service AWS Terraform deployment platform, and delivery for a **12+ member team across 23+ AI initiatives** — generating **750K+ automated requests and 42K+ hours saved in FY26**. He holds **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02)** and **NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI (NCP-AAI)**, founded **Surya HANA Academy** (~1,000 professionals trained) and **Suryagentic Institute**, and maintains **50 public open-source AI repositories** (`github.com/nagarjunak-pixel`, 2,249+ annual contributions).

- [`aether-compiler`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aether-compiler): MLIR / Tensor Graph Compiler & H100 Autotuner — MLIR/TorchInductor-style typed SSA tensor graph compiler featuring algebraic/CSE/DCE & epilogue fusion pipelines, a native C++20 linear-scan static arena memory planner (3.60× compression), polyhedral H100 tile & CuTe 32→1 bank-conflict autotuner, and live Qwen-3.5-4B CEGIS synthesis.
- [`nexus-verity`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/nexus-verity): Causal Discovery, Double/Debiased ML & Conformal Engine — Pearl Causal DAG & PC-Stable structure discovery (SHD = 0), Chernozhukov cross-fitted Double/Debiased ML (919× Simpson's bias reduction), finite-sample split conformal prediction, native C++20 doubly-robust policy evaluator, and live Qwen-3.5-4B causal CEGIS.
- [`tracegit`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit): Local-First Git for AI Agent Execution Traces — native C++20 Wagner–Fischer trajectory alignment (diff + bisect), loop-thrash detector, content-addressable SHA-256 Merkle DAG store, CI regression gate, and a drop-in Claude Code / Cursor MCP server.
- [`syntara`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara): Grammar-constrained structured decoding: JSON Schema/regex → minimal byte DFA → native C++20 prefix-sharing token index (112–142×, bit-exact), byte-level Earley CFG constraints, and exact closed-set choice scoring. 20/20 schema-valid outputs vs 1/20 unconstrained; 157 tests at 99.7% coverage.
- [`tokendiet`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tokendiet): Drop-in AI agent context compressor: native C++20 order-preserving salience knapsack, Python AST skeletonizer, cross-turn read dedup, cascade FinOps router, and Claude Code MCP server. Live qwen3.5:4b audit: 6/6 accuracy preserved with 70.25% prompt-token reduction; 14 tests at 97.72% coverage.
- [`slopguard`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/slopguard): Sub-second AI code & UI anti-slop verifier: C++20 byte prescreener, Python AST & TypeScript/JSX slop gate, Claude Code PostToolUse hook, and MCP server. Live qwen3.5:4b repair audit: 0/6 → 6/6 passing, 9 blockers eliminated; 12 tests at 97.12% coverage.
- [`vecta`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta): From-scratch vector search: HNSW (0.999 recall@10 touching 1.4% of vectors), IVF-PQ ADC + rerank (24× compression), RaBitQ-style 1-bit codes, BM25+RRF hybrid, and bit-exact native C++20 kernels (L2 7.8×, ADC 11.2×, Hamming 20.8×). mypy --strict, 99%+ branch coverage.
- [`weavegraph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph): Semantic code-graph worktree scheduler, min-cut multi-agent task partitioner, and 3-way AST semantic merge verifier (C++20 + Python + MCP + React). CI enforces ruff, mypy and a ≥95% coverage gate.
- [`calibra`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/calibra): Statistically rigorous LLM evaluation: paired bootstrap & exact McNemar, Bradley-Terry arena leaderboards with bootstrap CIs, 2PL IRT anchor benchmarking (38% lower error at 5% of items), temperature scaling, MinHash-LSH contamination detection & judge agreement. Validated with bit-exact C++20 kernels.
- [`helios-consensus`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/helios-consensus): FoundationDB-style deterministic-simulation Raft engine, TLA+-style explicit-state BFS model checker, Chained HotStuff 3-chain BFT finality, and C++20 jump-consistent-hash & CRC32C kernels.
- [`privora-graph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/privora-graph): Sovereign differential privacy (DP-SGD Rényi accountant), SQL:2011 bi-temporal Personalized-PageRank GraphRAG, Byzantine geometric-median aggregation, and a native C++20 CSR engine.

- [Eliminating Agent Loop-Thrash & Malformed Tool Calls (`tracegit` + `Syntara` + Global AI 500 & Complexity 100 Atlas)](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/articles/tracegit-syntara-deterministic-agent-traces-and-grammar-decoding.html): Empirical insights across 3,381 benchmarked repositories.

- [Verified Transformer Inference & Agent Context Compression (`AxiomZero` + `TokenDiet`)](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/articles/axiom-zero-tokendiet-speculative-kernels-sae-and-context-compression.html): Lossless C++20 speculative kernels, Top-K SAE steering, 1-UIP CDCL/RUP proof verification, and C++20 salience knapsack context pruning.

- [Official LinkedIn Hub, Newsletter & Pulse Index](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/linkedin-profile.html): Open-web mirror of `linkedin.com/in/nagarjuna-kamireddy`, `Autonomous SAP & Enterprise AI` daily newsletter, and LinkedIn Pulse articles.
